title: Execute rounded inverse-block boundary pages on the physical runtime
body:
This adds a source-bound physical bridge for PR4186's rounded inverse-block boundary pages: actual encoded page production and a literal lower/reversed-upper two-pass solver. It preserves borrowed input bytes, handles incomplete rows and RHS batches, and clears owned scratch. The kernel explicitly charges classical B³ scalar products; it makes no fast seven-product claim.

A discriminating execution on the same exact L/U and P=6 returns -13/64 under the retained scalar ABI and -12/64 under this blocked ABI. The checker compares every output to an independent rational oracle, validates B=2 and B=4 (n=5, half-bandwidth 3, three RHS columns), and rejects malformed padding, page tails, page aliases, all 25 metadata/page aliases, and distant-block couplings with cleanup.

Validation: registered normal and optimized runs PASS; committed-byte/source-history gate PASS (15 files); immutable exported bytes match the committed head; Git-free normal/optimized runs PASS. Source, typed-receipt, row-reversal and metadata-alias-guard mutations all reject, and the exported inventory is restored.

Still open: physical seven-product quadrant/recursion stack, actual caller RHS field gather, and original-S versus reference-LU integration. This is a partial physical bridge, not complete Core/Gaussian admission or a new kappa. Frozen predecessors are unchanged. Credit Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml PR4186 and physical Gaussian core, Vlado Vojdanovski's blocked proposal, Cinna Davis PR4100 and retained Gaussian/Harvey–van der Hoeven/runtime lineage. Prepared for JoyboyBrian with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no formal-kernel or independent human acceptance claimed.

Canonical claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4182#discussioncomment-19140225

Submission refresh: canonical main `4c0a359d88f22f05189d51f48387750b801a45d4`; governing guidance, selected record and this contribution's source inputs remain unchanged from the scientific base. Fresh overlap covers 309 open PR bodies, 4,156 Discussion records and all 6,760 local notes with complete reported pagination/inventory. New public deltas were checked; this remains advisory text coverage, excluding arbitrary diffs and unpublished work.
